name: sol_basics_al_11
description: Reuse of msg.value inside a loop causing multi-call double-counting of ETH value
question: The source file in `source` contains a loop (for/while) whose body references `msg.value` to credit, accumulate, or validate a per-iteration amount (e.g., adding msg.value to a balance, comparing msg.value against a per-item price, or passing msg.value to an external call each iteration), treating the constant transaction-wide msg.value as if it were a fresh amount per iteration, rather than using it once outside the loop or dividing/tracking a running remainder, so repeated iterations over-count or misattribute the same ETH value multiple times.
criteria: A for-loop over an array of recipients does `balances[recipients[i]] += msg.value;` inside the loop body
A while-loop iterating purchase items checks `require(msg.value >= itemPrice[i])` per iteration without deducting a running total
A loop calling an external contract passes `msg.value` as the value/argument on each iteration, e.g. `target.call{value: msg.value}(...)` inside a for-loop
A loop accumulates `totalDeposited += msg.value` for each address processed in a batch function
